title: Drophead
description:
Drophead: Drophead on a flat slab, i.e. a local thickening of the slab over a column. Thickness is additional to the thickness of the main slab. The material of the drophead is taken from the main slab property.
Also applicable to be used with waffle slabs for a solid zone over dropheads.

Thickness.description: Thickness of the drophead. The total thickness of the slab in the drophead zone will be the slab thickness + drophead thickness. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

XDimension.description: Extent of the drophead in the local x (primary) direction. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

YDimension.description: Extent of the drophead in the local y (secondary) direction. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

Reinforcement.description: Amount of reinforcement in the dropheads. Will be null if handled by the general Reinforcement layout. ReinforcementDensity: The reinforcement density of an element and its material.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
